probability_units: Fractions between 0 and 1; multiply by 100 to display percent.

fields.p4_aq: Unconditional P(selected via P4 champion AQ)
fields.g6_aq: Unconditional P(selected via highest-ranked G6 AQ)
fields.at_large: Unconditional P(selected via another at-large berth)
fields.strength_points: Model (Elo-1500)/28 at frozen cutoff, NOT Vegas line or committee ranking
fields.strength_rank: Within-138 model strength rank, NOT CFP committee rank
fields.conditional_title: P(title | this seed), null for zero sample
fields.p_model_iu: Mean IU single-match model probability conditional on reaching opponent round
fields.p_empirical: Fraction of synthetic simulations won; NOT historical performance
fields.ci95_pp: Monte Carlo 95% paired *simulation* interval, NOT real-world forecast CI

notes: Raw full-season input tables and all 100,000 private model trajectories are NOT published.
Short bracket samples are authentic selected V4.5 trajectories; selection does not estimate their frequency.
